correctness.rationale: Independently expanded the actual two-state matrix from source RESULT.md: Jury conditions are (100κs−49ξs+119ξ)/(10(10κ+7ξ))>0, 49sξ(ξ+1)/(10(10κ+7ξ))>0, and (400κ+42ξ−s(200κ+49ξ²−49ξ))/(10(10κ+7ξ))>0. Under κ≥1,0<ξ≤√κ,s>0 the first two are positive, so the third gives the exact iff. The boundary characteristic polynomial vanishes at −1. Direct symbolic subtraction yields the sign factor 14ξ(10−7ξ)/positive denominator; subtracting 400/249 gives a strictly positive term proportional to 1400(κ−ξ²)+2147ξ, while ξ=√κ,κ→∞ attains the infimum asymptotically. Source verify.py was inspected, but the independent SymPy matrix reduction rather than verifier exit code supports the formulas.
